title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Early and Late Shows) on 1970-01-02
lineage: SBD> MR> C> D> CD> EAC> SHN with aud patch

ai_review.summary: Crisp sound‑board capture of an iconic early‑1970 Fillmore East set highlighted by a blazing Dark Star → St. Stephen → Eleven → Lovelight sequence and stellar performances throughout.
ai_review.review: This recording delivers a clear, well‑balanced sound‑board mix that lets the band’s improvisational fire shine—particularly on the monumental Dark Star/Eleven/Lovelight stretch.  The show is praised for its hot jams (Mason’s Children, Casey Jones, High Time) and the tight rhythm section, though a few listeners note vocal level quirks, channel swaps and minor speed‑waver glitches.  Overall it stands as one of the most celebrated early‑70 performances.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (40+) are 4–5 stars and extol both musical moments and recording clarity; only a handful cite minor flaws, yielding an overall weighted rating around 4½.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound‑board source is generally crisp with clear instrument separation.  Reviewers note occasional vocal level being too low, right‑channel vocals on some tracks, and a few speed/pitch waver issues that require correction, but overall the mix is clean and listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The early set opens with the iconic Also‑Sprach‑Zarathustra intro and a solid first half; the late set erupts into deep, funk‑laden improvisations, culminating in a seamless Dark Star → St. Stephen → Eleven → Lovelight sequence that many reviewers cite as the show’s high point.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is repeatedly praised – tight licks on Dark Star, memorable riffs on Lovelight, and a playful chuckle during the jam.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass lines are highlighted as full and driving, especially on Lovelight where Phil’s “big fat bass” shines.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bobby) gets shout‑outs for vocal call‑and‑response in Lovelight and strong singing throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keyboard textures from Tom Constanten/Keith are noted as vibrant (‘TC’ organ, trippy synths), adding depth to jams; Pigpen’s keys also receive mention.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill and Mickey earn kudos for powerful drumming, with especially tight Eleven runs and dynamic rhythms that drive the late‑set improvisations.
